_comment: Oracle's Restoration reads 'Target creature YOU CONTROL gets +1/+1 until end of turn. You draw a card and gain 1 life.' With no creature of our own it has NO legal target and cannot be cast at all (CR 601.2c) -- the cantrip and the life are riders on a spell that never resolves, not a mode available on an empty board. TurnSolver's no-own-target branch used to emit an OPPONENT-target variant to cash exactly those riders, justified in-comment by 'the spell says target CREATURE, not target creature you control' -- true for Ancestral Anger / Fists of Flame / Impolite Entrance / Expedite, FALSE here; `trick_own_target_only` is what now separates the two. Found via reference game s27/gi26, where the search burned Oracle on T1 off an empty board for the cantrip and won a turn later than the human line that saved it for the T5 Zada+Mirrorwing fan. WHY expect_active_life IS THE ASSERTION: the illegal cast never wins and never touches the opponent, so expect_no_win and expect_opponent_life both pass whether or not the bug is present -- only our own life total moves (20 -> 21 via cast_lifegain). Board: one untapped Forest and NO creature of ours; the opponent has one, which is what opened the branch. Hand is Oracle's Restoration alone, so the correct play is to cast nothing.
